messages.content: This is Northline Care checking in for the week. How's everything going? Got a blood pressure reading, or anything you want me to pass along?
Yeah, 155/98 this morning. Been keeping up with my meds.

Got it — logging your reading and your medications. 155/98 is on the high side, so I've flagged it for one of our nurses to follow up. Heads up that the current wait is around 31 hours. Anything else to add?
Took you like 20 minutes just to send that back. And now 31 hours for a nurse? I really don't think this is worth my time.

That delay is frustrating and I'm sorry. I can't speed up the nurse queue, and I'm also not able to process opt-out requests — that would need to go through Northline Care support directly. Your flag is still in the system from today's reading.
I can't process that from here — to stop these messages, please contact Northline Care support. The nurse flag on your reading is still active. Take care.

theme: wants to opt out, sends STOP after a slow reply
